name: Question 8
problem: Find the equation of the tangent hyperplane to the hypersurface $w={x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-2{z}^{2}$ at the point $(1,1,1,0).$
worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of the tangent plane to the hypersurface $w=f(x,y,z)$ at the point $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0},{w}_{0})$ on the hypersurface can be written as

$$
w-{w}_{0}=(x-{x}_{0})\frac{∂f}{∂x}({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})+(y-{y}_{0})\frac{∂f}{∂y}({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})+(z-{z}_{0})\frac{∂f}{∂z}({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0}).
$$

First, we find the partial derivatives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-2{z}^{2})=2x \\ \frac{∂f}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-2{z}^{2})=2y \\ \frac{∂f}{∂z} & =\frac{∂}{∂z}({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-2{z}^{2})=-4z\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the partial derivatives at $(x,y,z)=(1,1,1):$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x}(1,1,1) & =2\cdot 1=2 \\ \frac{∂f}{∂y}(1,1,1) & =2\cdot 1=2 \\ \frac{∂f}{∂z}(1,1,1) & =-4\cdot 1=-4\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we write down the equation of the tangent hyperplane:

$$
\begin{aligned}w-0 & =(x-1)\frac{∂f}{∂x}(1,1,1)+(y-1)\frac{∂f}{∂y}(1,1,1)+(z-1)\frac{∂f}{∂z}(1,1,1) \\ w & =2(x-1)+2(y-1)-4(z-1) \\ w & =2x-2+2y-2-4z+4 \\ -2x-2y+4z+w & =0 \\ 2x+2y-4z-w & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Question 8
?

Find the equation of the tangent hyperplane to the hypersurface w=x2+y2−2z2 at the point (1,1,1,0).

a
2x+2y+4z−w−8=0
b
2x−2y+4z−w−4=0
c
2x−2y−4z+w+4=0
d
2x+2y−4z−w=0
e
2x+2y−4z+w=0
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The Cartesian equation of the tangent plane to the hypersurface w=f(x,y,z) at the point (x0,y0,z0,w0) on the hypersurface can be written as

w−w0=(x−x0)∂f∂x(x0,y0,z0)+(y−y0)∂f∂y(x0,y0,z0)+(z−z0)∂f∂z(x0,y0,z0).

First, we find the partial derivatives:

∂f∂x=∂∂x(x2+y2−2z2)=2x∂f∂y=∂∂y(x2+y2−2z2)=2y∂f∂z=∂∂z(x2+y2−2z2)=−4z

Next, we evaluate the partial derivatives at (x,y,z)=(1,1,1):

∂f∂x(1,1,1)=2⋅1=2∂f∂y(1,1,1)=2⋅1=2∂f∂z(1,1,1)=−4⋅1=−4

Finally, we write down the equation of the tangent hyperplane:

w−0=(x−1)∂f∂x(1,1,1)+(y−1)∂f∂y(1,1,1)+(z−1)∂f∂z(1,1,1)w=2(x−1)+2(y−1)−4(z−1)w=2x−2+2y−2−4z+4−2x−2y+4z+w=02x+2y−4z−w=0
